sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 31 points from 14 games, travel to Dawley Town on Saturday 31 October (KO 15:00). Despite a recent loss, the leaders remain in strong form overall, having won four of their last five league matches. Dawley, sitting 11th with 16 points, will look to upset the odds at home.
divisionWide: Second-placed AFC Bridgnorth (27 points) have a week without a fixture, while third-ranked Bilston Town also have no match scheduled, leaving the title race in Sandbach's hands. The standout Saturday clash sees fourth-placed Stafford Town (26 points) host fifth-placed Wolverhampton Casuals (25 points) at 15:00, a direct meeting between two in-form sides that could reshape the top-five picture. Eccleshall, unbeaten in their last three league games, face a quick turnaround after their Tuesday visit to Telford Town (27 October, KO 19:45), then host Shawbury United on Saturday—Shawbury are in sharp decline with just one win in their last six. Barnton travel to Foley Meir on Saturday in a mid-table battle, while Allscott Heath host Wolverhampton Casuals. In-form Allscott (four consecutive wins in the league) will test Casuals' credentials. New Mills face Wednesfield Community, and Cheadle Heath Nomads play Brereton Social in a lower-mid-table encounter. Market Drayton Town host Crewe, and Widnes Town travel to Alsager Town—both are struggling sides near the bottom, with Telford Town's midweek visit to host Eccleshall part of a difficult run for the league's lowest-ranked team.
